ops.text: Use pnpm in this repo: never run npm install, and delete package-lock.json if it appears.
Store money amounts as integer cents, never floats. Convert with toCents and format with formatCents from src/lib/money.ts. Do not use parseFloat for amounts.
Do not add UI libraries such as headlessui; use the project's own components in src/ui (Select, Dialog, Button) for UI controls.
New posts must have `draft: true` in their frontmatter until the user reviews them; never set `draft: false` on a new post.
Store post images in `public/images/<post-slug>/` and use the `.webp` format only.
Place unit test files next to the module they test (e.g. src/domain/budget.test.ts); never create __tests__ folders.
Never hand-edit src/api/generated; it is generated from openapi.yaml. Add new endpoints to openapi.yaml, then run pnpm gen:api to regenerate.
Use npm for package management in this project (package-lock.json is present); never use pnpm or create pnpm-lock.yaml.
Keep business logic out of components: put calculations in src/domain and expose them to components through a hook in src/hooks.
Store dates in UTC and convert them through src/lib/dates.ts (date-fns-tz, user timezone) for display and comparisons; never compare local new Date() values directly.
Write all UI copy in British English (colour, categorise, organisation, and similar spellings) because this is a UK product.
Default currency is GBP, not USD; the UK product's money formatting and currency selectors should start from GBP.
Never use emojis in post content, including headings; keep headings plain text.
Before reporting a task as done, run both `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck` and fix any failures; CI fails on lint.
Never commit or push changes to git; leave all work uncommitted in the working tree so the user can review the diff themselves.
Store money as integer cents end to end; convert with toCents and format with formatCents from src/lib/money.ts. Never use parseFloat, toFixed, Math.round or *100 on amounts.
Use British English spelling (organise, colour, categorise) in all text: UI copy, code comments, docs and error messages, since this is a UK product.
Do not add UI libraries such as headlessui; use the project's own components in src/ui (Select, Dialog, Button) for UI controls.
Store post images in `public/images/<post-slug>/` and use the `.webp` format only.
Before reporting a task as done, run `bun run lint` and `bun run typecheck` and fix any failures; CI fails on lint.
Use bun in this repo: run `bun install` and `bun run <script>`; never run npm or pnpm, and delete package-lock.json or pnpm-lock.yaml if they appear.
Never hand-edit src/api/generated; it is generated from openapi.yaml. Add new endpoints to openapi.yaml, then run `bun run gen:api` to regenerate.
Commit each finished task as one commit with a conventional commit message (feat:, fix:, etc.); never push to a remote.
